name: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks up to a Limit of Rs.5 Lakh for Self-Employment
benefit: - 6% interest subsidy on loans taken through banks. - Maximum loan amount eligible: ₹5,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of tribal areas in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have availed a bank loan for self-employment purposes.
